criteria.criteria_status: Declared before inspecting generated validation results. Exploratory adequacy screens, not physical calibration or extreme-risk certification.

observed.zero_frequency_meaning: Quantified zero includes trace lower bounds; not strictly observed meteorological dryness

generated.zero_frequency_meaning: Quantified zero includes trace lower bounds; not strictly observed meteorological dryness

copula_var.matched_support_policy: Generated diagnostics use the identical per-variable missingness mask as heldout observations. Missing rainfall terminates both event series; full generated array remains unmasked for physical checks.
copula_var.lag_direction: rows=current variable; columns=variable lag hours earlier
copula_var.anomaly_correlations: Each sample's local month/hour means removed for descriptive validation only; generator never refitted on heldout data
copula_var.storm_definition: Quantified rainfall >0; storms separated by >=6 quantified-zero hours, including trace lower bounds. Unquantified trace is omitted from storm amount/occurrence; missing hours terminate events.

validation_population.type: one full-calendar independent generated realization versus chronologically held-out data

limitations: Failed storm or persistence checks prohibit interpreting this generator as a reliable flood-probability estimator.
One held-out calendar contains interannual sampling variation and incomplete observations; screen failures are retained, not tuned away.
Gaussian copula has no asymptotic upper-tail dependence; marginal tail extrapolation does not establish joint-extreme fidelity.
Empirical marginals/bootstrap cannot extrapolate beyond training component extremes; storm reassembly can nevertheless produce new event totals.
Monthly/hourly patterns, raw and anomaly correlations are diagnostics; no post hoc pass threshold is invented for them.

var.estimator: pairwise contiguous-hour covariance moments; A=C1 inv(C0)
var.residual_interpretation: Descriptive lag-one diagnostics on genuinely adjacent complete daylight residuals. No unconfigured residual-white-noise acceptance threshold is invented; missing nighttime cloudiness is not filled as observed data.

bootstrap.criterion: Maximum absolute training latent ACF at the configured block length must be < 0.2.
bootstrap.criterion_source: Existing prespecified fit_weather block-adequacy screen; unchanged.
bootstrap.interpretation: A failed screen means this block length truncates material remaining persistence. The benchmark has not passed the retained weather-persistence screen.

training_temporal_diagnostics.bootstrap_block_basis: 48 h preregistered benchmark covers two diurnal cycles. Training ACF at block length is checked against absolute 0.2; failure explicitly means remaining persistence exceeds this block, not permission to tune after validation. Block boundaries truncate dependence.

copula_var.diagnostic_scope: Weather-only held-out checks plus the existing training persistence screen; not proof of completed official FIT/mimo_srs work.
